description:
# EmblemAI MCP

EmblemAI is a hosted Model Context Protocol server that gives AI agents a full-featured crypto wallet plus **200+ tools** for trading, DeFi, NFTs, and on-chain analytics across **7 blockchains**:

- **Bitcoin** — native BTC, Ordinals inscriptions, Runes, BRC-20, Stamps / SRC-20, Alkanes, rare sats
- **Solana** — SOL + SPL tokens, Jupiter-routed swaps, Solana memecoin discovery, RugCheck
- **Ethereum** — native ETH, ERC-20, ERC-721 / ERC-1155 NFTs, ETH swaps
- **Base** — native ETH on L2, ERC-20, NFTs, Clanker discovery
- **BSC** — native BNB, BEP-20, FourMeme bonding-curve discovery and trading
- **Polygon** — native MATIC, ERC-20, swaps
- **Hedera** — HBAR, HTS tokens, MemeJob discovery and trading

Plus prediction markets via **Polymarket**, market research, conditional orders (limit / stop-loss / take-profit) on supported chains, and on-chain analytics.

## Quick start

The Smithery deployment connects directly to the hosted EmblemAI MCP at `https://emblemvault.ai/api/mcp`. You only need an API key:

1. Sign in at [emblemvault.ai](https://emblemvault.ai).
2. Open **Settings → Vault Access Key** and copy your key.
3. Paste it as the `apiKey` parameter in the Smithery connection form.

Browsing tools (`tools/list`) works anonymously, so you can inspect the catalog before authenticating.

## Auth modes

| Mode | When to use | Scope |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **API key** (`x-api-key`) | Unattended agents, cron jobs, server-to-server, any workflow that mints tokens or sends transactions | Full read + write, no expiry until revoked |
| **OAuth 2.0 + PKCE** (RFC 7591 Dynamic Client Registration) | Interactive sessions where a human can click a browser popup | Read-only `vault:read`, short-lived JWT |
| **x402 micropayments** | Pay-per-call across the public catalog without an account | Per-tool-call USDC settlement |

The Smithery deployment defaults to the API-key path, configured via the `apiKey` parameter (sent to the upstream as the `x-api-key` header).

## Enabling transactional tools

State-changing tools (sends, swaps, mints, conditional-trade creates) are hidden by default. Opt in by setting the `enableTransactions` parameter to `enabled` — Smithery's gateway forwards it as the `x-mcp-transactions: enabled` header. Transactional tools then surface in `tools/list` with a `-transaction` suffix, which makes them easy to allow- or block-list with wildcard rules in the host client.

Note: transactional tools also require API-key auth — OAuth bearers do not pass the `vault:write` gate.

## Specialized listings (filter)

The full 200-tool surface is wide. For Bitcoin-only, Solana-only, or any other curated slice, use the stdio bridge `@emblemvault/mcp` (npm) and set:

```
EMBLEMAI_TOOLS_FILTER="bitcoin*,*Rune*,*Inscription*"
```

The bridge applies the glob filter to both `tools/list` and `tools/call`, exposing only the matching subset to the host LLM. The hosted Smithery deployment always exposes the full catalog; the filter is a stdio-side feature.

## Categories

Trading · DeFi · NFTs · Wallet · Bitcoin Ordinals · Polymarket prediction markets · Cross-chain · Market analytics · Research / web search.

## Links

- Hosted MCP: `https://emblemvault.ai/api/mcp`
- Stdio bridge: `@emblemvault/mcp` ([github](https://github.com/EmblemCompany/Agent-skills/tree/main/mcp-bridge))
- Repo: [EmblemCompany/Agent-skills](https://github.com/EmblemCompany/Agent-skills)
- Web app: [emblemvault.ai](https://emblemvault.ai)
- Glama listing: [glama.ai/mcp/servers/EmblemCompany/Agent-skills](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/EmblemCompany/Agent-skills)
- Docs: [emblemvault.ai/docs/mcp](https://emblemvault.ai/docs/mcp)

## License

MIT (stdio bridge + documentation). Hosted MCP is managed SaaS.

apiKey.description: Generate at https://emblemvault.ai → Settings → Vault Access Key. tools/list works anonymously,

transactions.description:
Set to "enabled" to expose state-changing tools.
Omit for read-only.

tool_signatures.name: baseFindClankerTokens
tool_signatures.description: Find meme tokens on Base via Clanker (clanker.world). Returns tokens with price, market cap, 24h volume, and price changes. Use 'q' param to search by name/symbol. Sort by market-cap or created-at. To buy/sell Clanker tokens, use baseSwap — they are regular ERC20s on Base.

tool_signatures.name: baseGetBalances
tool_signatures.description: Get wallet balances on Base. CRITICAL: Use 'balance' for trades (exact units), NOT 'humanReadableBalance' (rounded for display).

tool_signatures.name: baseSwapQuote
tool_signatures.description: Get current USD price and swap quote for Base tokens. ALWAYS fetch fresh prices - crypto is volatile. Use 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE for native ETH.

tool_signatures.name: birdeyeTradeData
tool_signatures.description: Get detailed trade data for a specific token from Birdeye. Supported chains: solana, ethereum, arbitrum, avalanche, bsc, optimism, polygon, base, zksync, sui. NOT supported: Hedera (use hederaTokensSwapQuote instead).

chain.description: Chain to fetch token data from. NOT supported: hedera

address.description: Token address to fetch trade data for

tool_signatures.name: birdeyeTrendingTokens
tool_signatures.description: Get trending tokens from Birdeye with real-time price and market data. Supports multiple chains and sorting options.

chain.description: Chain to fetch trending tokens from (e.g., solana, ethereum)

limit.description: Number of trending tokens to fetch (MAX 5)

sortBy.description: Field to sort by. Currently only supports "rank"

sortType.description: Sort direction: "asc" for ascending, "desc" for descending

tool_signatures.name: bscGetBalances
tool_signatures.description: Return the user's wallet holdings on BNB Smart Chain (chain ID 56): native BNB plus all detected BEP-20 token balances with contract address, symbol, decimals, and USD value where pricing is available.

tool_signatures.name: bscSwapQuote
tool_signatures.description: Get swap quote for BSC tokens. Uses Uniswap X or 0x. Use 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE for native BNB.

tool_signatures.name: bscfindMemeCoinsViaFourMeme
tool_signatures.description: Find meme coins on BSC via FourMeme. Market cap is in BNB, price in USD.

tool_signatures.name: checkRuneUnlock
tool_signatures.description: Check when a specific rune name becomes available to etch.

name.description: The name of the rune (spacers like • are automatically removed)

tool_signatures.name: discoverLaunchLabTokens
tool_signatures.description: Get LaunchLab / bonk.fun tokens. Pass size=5, paginate with nextPageId.

tool_signatures.name: emblemGetCollectionAssets
tool_signatures.description: Get all assets within a specific curated collection for vault creation

collectionName.description: Collection name (e.g., "Darkfarms", "SoG") - use emblem list collections first

tool_signatures.name: emblemGetDepositAddress
tool_signatures.description: Get the deposit address for a vault where you can send assets. Shows which coins are accepted.

tokenId.description: The vault token ID - get from emblem list my vaults

tool_signatures.name: emblemListCollections
tool_signatures.description: List all available curated collections for vault creation with asset details

showAll.description: Show all collections including hidden ones

tool_signatures.name: emblemListMyVaults
tool_signatures.description: List all vaults owned by the connected wallet (or a specified address), with optional filtering by status

status.description: Filter by vault status - empty to show all

address.description: EVM wallet address (0x...). Omit to use connected wallet.

tool_signatures.name: emblemResolveAsset
tool_signatures.description: Resolve an asset name to its curated collection. CRITICAL: Call this BEFORE emblemCreateVault when vaulting user assets to find the correct collection name.

assetName.description: The asset name from user wallet (e.g., "TESTNETPEPE", "PEPECASH", "FDCARD")

tool_signatures.name: ethGetBalances
tool_signatures.description: Get wallet balances on Ethereum. CRITICAL: Use 'balance' for trades (exact units), NOT 'humanReadableBalance' (rounded for display).

tool_signatures.name: ethSwapQuote
tool_signatures.description: Get current USD price and swap quote for Ethereum tokens. ALWAYS fetch fresh prices - crypto is volatile. Use 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE for native ETH.

tool_signatures.name: findPositionById
tool_signatures.description:
Find a conditional trade position by ID across ALL networks.
Use this when you have a position ID but don't know which network it's on.

tool_signatures.name: findSolanaGems
tool_signatures.description: Discover trending Solana tokens or tokenized stocks. category='tokens': memecoins, DeFi tokens, SPL tokens (trending, popular, top traded, organic, new). category='stocks': tokenized equities on Solana (PreStocks, xStocks, rStocks) with real stock prices. Use for: 'trending tokens', 'find gems', 'top traded memecoins', 'show stocks on solana', 'TSLA stock token'. NOT for: specific token lookup (use findSolanaSwapToken), PumpFun queries (use getPumpFunTokens).

sortBy.description: Sort/ranking method (only applies to category='tokens', ignored for stocks)

category.description: 'tokens' for crypto tokens/memecoins, 'stocks' for tokenized equities

maxVolume.description: Max volume in USD for the given timeframe

minVolume.description: Min volume in USD for the given timeframe

timeframe.description: Timeframe for volume and price change stats

maxNetVolume.description: Max net volume (buy - sell) in USD

minNetVolume.description: Min net volume (buy - sell) in USD

tool_signatures.name: findSolanaSwapToken
tool_signatures.description: Find a Solana token by name or symbol. Use when splBuyIntent reports ambiguous token symbol.

tokenName.description: Token name or symbol to search

tool_signatures.name: firecrawlExtract
tool_signatures.description: Investigate or Extract structured data from web pages or urls using Firecrawl

tool_signatures.name: getAlkaneAddressBalance
tool_signatures.description: Get the alkane balance for a Bitcoin address. This includes tokens, NFTs, contracts, and any other type of alkane.

tool_signatures.name: getAlkaneAddressUTXOs
tool_signatures.description: Get the UTXOs for a given Bitcoin address. This includes tokens, NFTs, contracts, and any other type of alkane.

tool_signatures.name: getAlkaneInfo
tool_signatures.description: Fetch metadata for a single Alkane by its protocol ID: name, symbol, supply, type, and contract details if applicable.

id.description: Alkane protocol ID in 'block:tx' format (e.g. '2:42'). Both components are required.

tool_signatures.name: getAllPositions
tool_signatures.description:
Get ALL conditional trade positions across ALL networks
(Solana, Ethereum, BSC, Polygon, Hedera) in a single call.
Optionally filter by position status: OPEN, CLOSED, CANCELLED, FAILED.

tool_signatures.name: getBRC20Activity
tool_signatures.description: Return the BRC-20 token transfer history for a given Bitcoin address (deploys, mints, transfers, sends, receives) with timestamps and amounts. Paginated.

bitcoinAddress.description: Bitcoin address whose BRC-20 activity to retrieve.

tool_signatures.name: getBRC20TokenInfo
tool_signatures.description: Fetch protocol + market metadata for a single BRC-20 token by ticker: current USD price, total supply, max supply, mint progress, holder count, and market cap.

ticker.description: BRC-20 token ticker, typically 4 characters (e.g. 'ORDI', 'SATS'). Case-insensitive.

tool_signatures.name: getBTCBalances
tool_signatures.description: Return native BTC balances for the user's wallet, broken out by both the taproot (P2TR) and nested segwit (P2WPKH) addresses, in BTC and sats. Does NOT include runes, ordinals/inscriptions, or Counterparty assets — use the dedicated getRuneBalances / getInscriptionsByAddress / getXCPBalances tools for those.

tool_signatures.name: getBitcoinCollections
tool_signatures.description: Browse all indexed Bitcoin Ordinals inscription collections (paginated). Returns each collection's slug, name, supply, and identifiers — useful for discovery before drilling into floor price or assets via getCollectionInfo / getCollectionMarketInfo.

page.description: 1-indexed page number for paginating the collections list. Omit for the first page.

tool_signatures.name: getChangeNowSupportedCurrencies
tool_signatures.description: Get supported currencies for cross-chain swaps

tool_signatures.name: getChangeNowSwapQuote
tool_signatures.description: Get a swap quote for cross-chain exchange. Tickers must be supported by ChangeNow.

fromAmount.description: Amount of source currency (e.g., 1 for 1 ETH)

tool_signatures.name: getCoinglassBitcoinETFNetAssetsHistory
tool_signatures.description: Historical net assets data for Bitcoin-based Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs)

tool_signatures.name: getCoinglassBitcoinEtfList
tool_signatures.description: Provides a list of Bitcoin-based Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs)

tool_signatures.name: getCoinglassBitfinexMarginData
tool_signatures.description: Provides data on margin long and short positions from Bitfinex

symbol.description: The symbol of the cryptocurrency. example BTC

tool_signatures.name: getCoinglassBorrowInterestRate
tool_signatures.description: Provides daily borrowing interest rates for cryptocurrencies

symbol.description: The symbol of the cryptocurrency. example BTC

exchange.description: The exchange of the cryptocurrency. example binance

tool_signatures.name: getCoinglassCDRIIndex
tool_signatures.description: Provides historical CDRI (CoinGlass Derivatives Risk Index) data

tool_signatures.name: getCoinglassCGDIIndex
tool_signatures.description: Provides historical CGDI (CoinGlass Derivatives Index) data

tool_signatures.name: getCoinglassEthereumETFNetAssetsHistory
tool_signatures.description: Historical net assets data for Ethereum-based Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs)

tool_signatures.name: getCoinglassEthereumEtfList
tool_signatures.description: Get the list of Ethereum ETFs with pagination

tool_signatures.name: getCoinglassExchangeAssets
tool_signatures.description: Provides asset holdings data for exchange wallets, including address, balance, USD value, and price info

exchange.description: The exchange of the cryptocurrency. example binance

tool_signatures.name: getCoinglassExchangeBalanceList
tool_signatures.description: Provides a list of exchange balances for a given symbol

tool_signatures.name: getCoinglassFutureBasis
tool_signatures.description: Provides historical futures basis data, including open and close basis rates and annualized percentage changes

tool_signatures.name: getCoinglassFuturesWhaleIndex
tool_signatures.description: Provides a list of futures whale index data

tool_signatures.name: getCoinglassGrayscaleHoldings
tool_signatures.description: Provides a list of holdings managed by Grayscale Investments

tool_signatures.name: getCoinglassHyperliquidWhaleAlert
tool_signatures.description: Provides real-time whale alerts on Hyperliquid, highlighting positions with notional value over $1M

tool_signatures.name: getCoinglassHyperliquidWhalePosition
tool_signatures.description: Provides real-time whale position data on Hyperliquid

tool_signatures.name: getCoinglassOnChainTransfers
tool_signatures.description: Provides on-chain transfer records (ERC-20) for exchanges

tool_signatures.name: getCoinglassOpenInterestHistory
tool_signatures.description: Provides historical open interest data for options across different exchanges

symbol.description: The symbol of the cryptocurrency. example: BTC

tool_signatures.name: getCoinglassOptionsInfo
tool_signatures.description: Provides detailed information about open interest and trading volume for options across exchanges

symbol.description: The symbol of the cryptocurrency. example: BTC

tool_signatures.name: getCoinglassPremiumIndex
tool_signatures.description: Provides the Coinbase Bitcoin Premium Index, indicating price difference between Coinbase Pro and Binance

tool_signatures.name: getCollectionInfo
tool_signatures.description: Fetch a Bitcoin Ordinals collection's metadata by its slug: name, description, supply, twitter, website, and image. Pair with getCollectionMarketInfo for floor/market data.

slug.description: Collection slug as indexed by Ordiscan (e.g. 'taproot-wizards', 'nodemonkes').

tool_signatures.name: getCollectionInscriptions
tool_signatures.description: List the inscriptions that belong to a given Bitcoin Ordinals collection (the collection's items). Returns inscription IDs and basic metadata.

slug.description: Collection slug as indexed by Ordiscan (e.g. 'taproot-wizards').

tool_signatures.name: getCollectionMarketInfo
tool_signatures.description: Get market info for a Bitcoin inscription collection: floor price in sats and USD, market cap in BTC and USD. Use this when user asks about collection prices, valuations, or floor prices.

tool_signatures.name: getCollectionVolume
tool_signatures.description: Get trading volume and market stats for a Bitcoin ordinal collection from Magic Eden. Returns total volume, floor price, supply, owners, and listings. Use this for questions about collection trading activity or volume.

tool_signatures.name: getCryptoPrice
tool_signatures.description: Get the current USD price of a major cryptocurrency. Use this when the user asks about the price, value, or worth of BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB, or HBAR. This is the PRIMARY tool for answering questions like 'What's Bitcoin worth?', 'ETH price', 'How much is SOL?', or 'Tell me about Bitcoin'.

tool_signatures.name: getInscriptionActivity
tool_signatures.description: Return the inscription transfer history for a given Bitcoin address (incoming and outgoing inscription movements with timestamps and counterparties), paginated.

bitcoinAddress.description: Bitcoin address whose inscription activity to retrieve.

tool_signatures.name: getInscriptionInfo
tool_signatures.description: Fetch metadata for a single Bitcoin Ordinals inscription: content type, content URL, current owner, satpoint, inscription number, genesis transaction, and timestamp.

tool_signatures.name: getInscriptionTraits
tool_signatures.description: Fetch the trait/attribute set for a single Bitcoin inscription (NFT-style traits used for collection rarity ranking). Returns an empty array when no traits are indexed.

tool_signatures.name: getInscriptionsByAddress
tool_signatures.description: Return paginated, fully-detailed Bitcoin Ordinals inscriptions held by a given Bitcoin address (number, content type, traits, satpoint). Use this to display a wallet's NFT-style holdings.

page.description: 1-indexed page number for paginating large inscription sets. Omit for the first page.

bitcoinAddress.description: Bitcoin address whose inscriptions to fetch.

tool_signatures.name: getLatestInscriptions
tool_signatures.description: Browse the most recently created Bitcoin Ordinals inscriptions network-wide (newest first by default). Use this to discover newly-minted inscriptions, NOT to look up inscriptions on a specific address.

sort.description: Sort order: 'inscription_number_desc' for newest first, 'inscription_number_asc' for oldest first.

after.description: Cursor: return inscriptions with inscription number greater than this value.

before.description: Cursor: return inscriptions with inscription number less than this value.

tool_signatures.name: getLatestRunes
tool_signatures.description: List the latest Rune tokens for market discovery and browsing. Use this when user wants to see new/trending Runes, NOT for checking their personal balance.

tool_signatures.name: getLeaderboard
tool_signatures.description: Emblem ecosystem trading leaderboard

page.description: The page number of the leaderboard

orderBy.description: The order by of the leaderboard

pageSize.description: The page size of the leaderboard

tool_signatures.name: getMagicEdenRunePrice
tool_signatures.description: Get rune market data from Magic Eden as an alternative data source. Use this if Ordiscan returns zero prices for a rune.

runeName.description: The rune name without bullet spacers (e.g., 'DOGGOTOTHEMOON')

tool_signatures.name: getOwnedInscriptionIds
tool_signatures.description: Return the list of Bitcoin Ordinals inscription IDs owned by a given Bitcoin address. Lightweight ID-only response — use getInscriptionsByAddress for full inscription metadata.

bitcoinAddress.description: Bitcoin address whose owned inscription IDs to fetch.

tool_signatures.name: getPolyMarketEvent
tool_signatures.description: Get detailed info for a specific Polymarket event by slug

tool_signatures.name: getPolyMarketEvents
tool_signatures.description: Get Polymarket events list. Returns compacted data.

tag_id.description: Tag ID to filter by. Use getPolyMarketTags to get IDs.

tool_signatures.name: getPolyMarketEvents
tool_signatures.description: Get Polymarket events list. Returns compacted data optimized for efficiency.

tag_id.description: Tag ID to filter by. Use getPolyMarketTags to get IDs.

tool_signatures.name: getPolyMarketEventsByTag
tool_signatures.description: Get Polymarket events by tag/category

tool_signatures.name: getPolyMarketEventsByTag
tool_signatures.description: Get Polymarket events filtered by tag/category

tool_signatures.name: getPolyMarketTags
tool_signatures.description: Get Polymarket categories/tags

tool_signatures.name: getPolyMarketTags
tool_signatures.description: Get Polymarket categories/tags for filtering events

tool_signatures.name: getPolyMarketUserPositions
tool_signatures.description: Get user's Polymarket positions

limit.description: The limit of positions to get

offset.description: The offset of the positions to get

tool_signatures.name: getPumpFunTokens
tool_signatures.description: Query PumpFun tokens (new, graduating, graduated)

devHoldPercent_gte.description: dev hold percent greater than value

devHoldPercent_lte.description: dev hold percent less than value

tool_signatures.name: getRareSats
tool_signatures.description: List rare sats (uncommon, rare, epic, legendary, or named single-satoshi units) controlled by a given Bitcoin address. Useful for collectors evaluating sat rarity holdings.

bitcoinAddress.description: Bitcoin address whose rare-sat inventory to look up.

tool_signatures.name: getRecentStamps
tool_signatures.description: Browse the most recently issued Bitcoin Stamps (newest first) for discovery. Returns asset name, image preview, creator, and timestamp. Use this for activity feeds and 'what's new' surfaces.

limit.description: Number of recent stamps to return (1-100). Defaults to 10.

tool_signatures.name: getRuneBalances
tool_signatures.description: Get the user's Rune token balances.

bitcoinAddress.description: The Bitcoin taproot address to check rune balances for

tool_signatures.name: getRuneInfo
tool_signatures.description: Fetch protocol-level metadata for a Rune token by name: ID, supply, divisibility, symbol, premine, etching transaction, and lock height.

name.description: Rune name (spacers like • are stripped automatically; case-insensitive). Example: 'DOG•GO•TO•THE•MOON' or 'DOGGOTOTHEMOON'.

tool_signatures.name: getRuneMarketInfo
tool_signatures.description: Get the market info for a given rune name: price, market cap

name.description: The name of the rune (spacers like • are automatically removed)

tool_signatures.name: getRunesActivity
tool_signatures.description: Return the Rune transfer history for a given Bitcoin address (etching, mints, sends, receives) with timestamps, amounts, and counterparties. Paginated.

bitcoinAddress.description: Bitcoin address whose rune activity to retrieve.

tool_signatures.name: getSRC20Token
tool_signatures.description: Fetch metadata for a single SRC-20 token (the Bitcoin Stamps fungible-token standard) by ticker: deploy info, max supply, mint progress, holder count, and creator. SRC-20 is the Stamps protocol equivalent of BRC-20.

tick.description: SRC-20 token ticker, typically 4 characters (e.g. 'KEVIN', 'STAMP'). Case-insensitive.

tool_signatures.name: getSatRangesForUTXO
tool_signatures.description: Return the ordinal-numbered sat ranges contained in a single UTXO (the satoshi-by-satoshi composition). Useful for ordinal theory analysis and rare-sat lookups.

tool_signatures.name: getStamp
tool_signatures.description: Fetch metadata for a single Bitcoin Stamp (Stampchain.io) by ID: image data, creator address, block height, asset name, and SRC20 association if any. Bitcoin Stamps embed permanent on-chain image data via the Counterparty/STAMP protocol.

stampId.description: Numeric stamp ID assigned at issuance (e.g. '12345'). Stamp IDs are assigned sequentially by Stampchain.

tool_signatures.name: getStampsByAddress
tool_signatures.description: List the Bitcoin Stamps and SRC-20 token balances held by a given Bitcoin address. Returns each held stamp's ID + asset name and SRC-20 holdings with amounts.

bitcoinAddress.description: Bitcoin address (Counterparty-compatible) whose stamp holdings to retrieve.

tool_signatures.name: getTopBRC20ByMarketCap
tool_signatures.description: Get BRC-20 tokens ranked by market cap. Use this to find the most valuable BRC-20 tokens. Returns price, market cap, 24h volume, and price change.

minMarketCap.description: Filter for tokens with market cap above this value in USD

tool_signatures.name: getTopBRC20ByVolume
tool_signatures.description: Get BRC-20 tokens ranked by 24h trading volume. Use this to find the most actively traded BRC-20 tokens. Returns price, market cap, 24h volume, and price change.

minVolume.description: Filter for tokens with 24h volume above this value in USD

tool_signatures.name: getTopCollectionsByFloor
tool_signatures.description: Get Bitcoin ordinal collections ranked by floor price from Magic Eden. Use this when user asks about 'most expensive collections' or 'highest floor price ordinals'.

tool_signatures.name: getTopCollectionsByVolume
tool_signatures.description: Get Bitcoin ordinal collections ranked by trading volume from Magic Eden. Use this when user asks about 'inscriptions with most volume', 'top trading collections', or 'hottest ordinal collections'.

tool_signatures.name: getTopRunesByMarketCap
tool_signatures.description: Get Bitcoin runes ranked by market cap. Use this to find the most valuable runes by market capitalization. Returns price, market cap, 24h volume, and price change.

minMarketCap.description: Filter for runes with market cap above this value in USD

tool_signatures.name: getTopRunesByVolume
tool_signatures.description: Get Bitcoin runes ranked by 24h trading volume. Use this to find the most actively traded runes. Returns price, market cap, 24h volume, and price change.

minVolume.description: Filter for runes with 24h volume above this value in USD

tool_signatures.name: getTrendingCoins
tool_signatures.description: Get currently trending cryptocurrencies on CoinGecko. Shows coins with highest search interest in the last 24 hours.

tool_signatures.name: getUtxoRunes
tool_signatures.description: List the unspent transaction outputs (UTXOs) on a Bitcoin address that hold Rune tokens, including the rune name, amount, and UTXO reference. Useful for inspecting a wallet's individual rune-bearing UTXOs before sending or splitting them.

bitcoinAddress.description: Bitcoin address to scan for rune-bearing UTXOs (taproot or legacy).

tool_signatures.name: getXCPBalances
tool_signatures.description: Return the user's legacy Bitcoin (P2PKH) wallet holdings on the Counterparty layer: XCP balance, named Counterparty assets, Bitcoin Stamps, and rare pepes — each with asset name, supply, and divisibility metadata.

tool_signatures.name: hederaAccountIdToEvmAddress
tool_signatures.description: Resolve a Hedera account ID in '0.0.x' realm-shard-num form to its 0x-prefixed EVM address by querying the Hedera mirror node (returns the account's alias or auto-generated EVM address).

tool_signatures.name: hederaContractIdToEvmAddress
tool_signatures.description: Convert a Hedera contract ID in '0.0.x' realm-shard-num form to its 0x-prefixed EVM address representation. Pure conversion — does not query the network.

tool_signatures.name: hederaFindMemeCoins
tool_signatures.description: Browse Hedera meme tokens listed on the MemeJob bonding-curve launchpad. Sort by market cap, creation time, last activity, or nearest-promoted; paginated for discovery feeds.

page.description: 0-indexed page number (defaults to 0 for first page).

orderDirection.description: Sort direction: 'desc' for largest/newest first, 'asc' for opposite.

tool_signatures.name: hederaFindTokens
tool_signatures.description: Search Hedera-listed tokens by name or symbol (substring, case-insensitive). Returns matching tokens with EVM address, name, symbol, and decimals. Omit the query to list all tokens.

query.description: Free-text query against token name and symbol (case-insensitive substring match). Omit to return the full SaucerSwap token list.

tool_signatures.name: hederaTokensSwapQuote
tool_signatures.description: Get current USD price and swap quote for Hedera tokens. ALWAYS fetch fresh - crypto prices change every second. Supports exact input (spend X) and exact output (receive Y) modes.

amount.description: Amount to swap (for exact input mode)

fromTokenId.description: Token to swap from (0.0.000000 for HBAR)

exactOutputAmount.description: Exact output amount (for exact output mode)

tool_signatures.name: inscriptionTransferActivity
tool_signatures.description: Return the full ownership transfer history for a single Bitcoin inscription: every move with timestamp, from-address, to-address, and transaction hash.

tool_signatures.name: isFourMemeToken
tool_signatures.description: Check whether a BSC token contract is registered on FourMeme and is still on the bonding curve (not yet listed / migrated off the curve). Returns the FourMeme token record if found.

tokenAddress.description: BSC token contract address to check against the FourMeme registry (0x-prefixed).

tool_signatures.name: listAlkanes
tool_signatures.description: Browse Alkanes (Bitcoin smart-contract / token / NFT primitives anchored on Bitcoin), filtered by type. Use this for market discovery; pair with getAlkaneInfo for per-asset detail.

page.description: 1-indexed page for paginating the alkane list.

sort.description: Sort order: 'newest' for most recent first, 'oldest' for chronological.

type.description: Alkane category to filter by: 'TOKEN' (fungible), 'CONTRACT' (deployed contract), 'NFT_COLLECTION' (collection), 'NFT_ITEM' (single NFT).

tool_signatures.name: listBRC20Tokens
tool_signatures.description: List all BRC-20 tokens in the market for discovery and browsing. Use this when user wants to see available tokens, NOT for checking their personal balance.

page.description: 1-indexed page for paginating the BRC-20 token list.

sort.description: Sort order: 'newest' for most recent deploys first, 'oldest' for chronological.

tool_signatures.name: listPositions
tool_signatures.description: List conditional trade positions. If network is provided, lists positions for that specific network. If no network is provided, lists ALL positions across all supported networks (Solana, Ethereum, BSC, Polygon, Hedera, Base).

network.description: Specific network to list positions for. If omitted, lists across all networks.

tool_signatures.name: nansen_defi_portfolio
tool_signatures.description: Get a wallet's DeFi portfolio: LP positions, lending, staking, farming across protocols.

tool_signatures.name: nansen_perp_positions
tool_signatures.description: Get current Hyperliquid perpetual positions held by smart money for a specific token.

tool_signatures.name: nansen_pnl_leaderboard
tool_signatures.description: Get Nansen PnL leaderboard for a SPECIFIC TOKEN CONTRACT (not a global wallet leaderboard). Requires a token contract address. Shows which wallets profited most from trading that specific token.

tool_signatures.name: nansen_smart_money_flows
tool_signatures.description: Get net token flows from smart money addresses. Shows accumulation/distribution by funds and whales.

tool_signatures.name: nansen_smart_money_holdings
tool_signatures.description: Get current token holdings aggregated across smart money wallets. Shows what funds and whales are holding.

tool_signatures.name: nansen_smart_money_trades
tool_signatures.description: Get recent DEX trades by smart money wallets. Spot what top traders are actively buying/selling.

tool_signatures.name: nansen_token_screener
tool_signatures.description: Screen tokens by volume, smart money activity, and chain. Find trending tokens that smart money is trading.

smart_money_only.description: Filter to show only smart money activity

tool_signatures.name: nansen_wallet_profiler
tool_signatures.description: Profile a specific wallet — trading activity, PnL, token trades over a date range.

tool_signatures.name: nansen_who_bought_sold
tool_signatures.description: See which smart money wallets bought or sold a specific token in a date range.

tool_signatures.name: openseaGetBestListings
tool_signatures.description: Get the cheapest (best) listings for an NFT collection. Use this for price discovery and finding deals.

tool_signatures.name: openseaGetCollectionActivity
tool_signatures.description: Monitor recent activity for an NFT collection: sales, transfers, mints, listings, and offers. Use this to track market activity and recent trades.

eventType.description: Filter by event type (omit for all events)

tool_signatures.name: openseaGetCollectionStats
tool_signatures.description: Get detailed stats for an NFT collection including floor price, volume, sales, owners, and market cap. Use collection slug (e.g., 'boredapeyachtclub'), not the collection name.

tool_signatures.name: openseaGetMyNFTs
tool_signatures.description: Get all NFTs owned by the user on OpenSea. ALWAYS use this tool first when user asks about their NFTs or NFT collection.

limit.description: Maximum number of NFTs to return

tool_signatures.name: openseaGetNFTListings
tool_signatures.description: Get active sell listings for an NFT on OpenSea

tokenId.description: The token ID of the NFT

tool_signatures.name: openseaGetNFTOffers
tool_signatures.description: Get buy offers for an NFT on OpenSea

tokenId.description: The token ID of the NFT

tool_signatures.name: openseaGetTrendingCollections
tool_signatures.description: Find trending NFT collections by volume, market cap, or price changes. Use this for market research and discovering popular collections.

tool_signatures.name: polygonGetBalances
tool_signatures.description: Return the user's wallet holdings on Polygon (chain ID 137): native MATIC plus all detected ERC-20 token balances with contract address, symbol, decimals, and USD value where pricing is available.

tool_signatures.name: polygonSwapQuote
tool_signatures.description: Get swap quote for Polygon tokens. Uses Uniswap X or 0x. Use 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE for native MATIC.

tool_signatures.name: rareSatsForUTXO
tool_signatures.description: Inspect a single UTXO and report any rare sats it contains (uncommon, rare, epic, legendary, or named single-satoshi units). Returns an empty array if none.

tool_signatures.name: rugcheck
tool_signatures.description: Check if token is a rug/scam. score_normalised: 0=safe, 100=risky.

tool_signatures.name: searchCryptoByName
tool_signatures.description: Search for cryptocurrencies by name or symbol. Use this to find the correct token ID before getting detailed market data.

tool_signatures.name: searchEvmTokensBirdeye
tool_signatures.description: Search for evm tokens on Birdeye. Supports multiple chains like eth, polygon, bsc, base, etc.

chainId.description: Chain ID to search tokens on

tool_signatures.name: searchPolyMarketEvents
tool_signatures.description: Search Polymarket events by keyword. Returns compacted results.

tool_signatures.name: searchSRC20Tokens
tool_signatures.description: Search SRC-20 tokens (Bitcoin Stamps fungible standard) with filters: free-text, deployer address, sort by deploy time / holders / mint progress. Use for SRC-20 market discovery.

page.description: 1-indexed page number for paginating results (max 10000). Defaults to 5.

query.description: Free-text query against SRC-20 ticker, creator notes, and metadata.

sort_by.description: Sort field: 'deploy_timestamp' (newest deploys), 'holders' (most-held), 'percent_minted' (closest to fully minted).

deployer.description: Filter to SRC-20 tokens deployed by a specific Bitcoin address (26-62 chars).

page_size.description: Items per page (1-100). Defaults to API default.

tool_signatures.name: searchStamps
tool_signatures.description: Search the Bitcoin Stamps index (Stampchain.io) with multiple filters: free-text query, creator address, collection, Counterparty asset ID, BTC vs cursed filtering, and pagination. Use this for stamp discovery and curated collections.

cpid.description: Counterparty asset ID (CPID), e.g. 'A12345...', identifying a specific stamp asset.

limit.description: Hard cap on total results returned. Use as an alternative to page_size for one-shot calls.

query.description: Free-text query against stamp asset names, descriptions, and metadata.

creator.description: Filter to stamps issued by a specific Bitcoin/Counterparty creator address.

is_cursed.description: If true, only return cursed stamps (out-of-spec issuances); if false, exclude them.

page_size.description: Items per page (1-100). Defaults to API default.

sort_order.description: Result ordering by stamp number: 'ASC' (oldest first) or 'DESC' (newest first).

is_btc_stamp.description: If true, only return canonical BTC Stamps; if false, exclude them.

collection_id.description: Filter to stamps belonging to a Stampchain collection ID.

tool_signatures.name: solanaBalances
tool_signatures.description: Return the user's Solana wallet holdings: native SOL plus all SPL tokens with mint address, symbol, balance, decimals, and USD value where pricing is available.

tool_signatures.name: solanaGetTokenPairPrice
tool_signatures.description: Quote the spot exchange rate between two SPL tokens, routed across Solana DEX liquidity for best execution. Returns the rate of inputMint denominated in outputMint, plus the route taken.

inputMint.description: SPL mint address of the input token (the one being sold/spent). Use 'So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112' for wrapped SOL.

outputMint.description: SPL mint address of the output token (the one being bought). Use 'EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v' for USDC.

tool_signatures.name: solanaGetTokenPrices
tool_signatures.description: Batch-fetch USD spot prices for one or more SPL tokens. Returns each mint's USD price plus confidence level. More efficient than calling solanaGetTokenPairPrice in a loop.

tokenMints.description: List of SPL mint addresses to price (1-100). Each entry is a base58 mint pubkey.

tool_signatures.name: tokenMetadataInfo
tool_signatures.description: Get a token metadata and price info.

tool_signatures.name: wallet
tool_signatures.description: Get the connected wallet and vault info across all networks

tool_signatures.name: websearch
tool_signatures.description: Search the web for current news, information, and announcements. Use this for real-time market insights and breaking news.Do NOT use it for real-time price data for prices and swaps, use quote tools instead.
